replacements.La misma cantidad expresada de formas ra: The same quantity expressed in radically different ways. What changes is not the numbers themselves, but which operations become possible.
replacements.Un trazo por unidad. No hay símbolo para: One stroke per unit. There is no symbol for "zero" or for abstract quantities: each mark represents a concrete object.
replacements.El salto conceptual fue separar el símbo: The conceptual leap was to separate the symbol from the object: the notch is not the sheep; it represents it.
replacements.Imperio Romano · ≈ siglo IV a.C. – s. XI: Roman Empire · ≈ 4th century BCE – 14th century CE
replacements.Sistema aditivo con símbolos fijos para: An additive system with fixed symbols for key values. Position matters (IV ≠ VI), but it is not positional in the modern sense.
replacements.Multiplicación y división razonables (XL: Practical multiplication and division (XLII × XXIII is an ordeal)
replacements.Sin cero ni posición, la aritmética era: Without zero or positional notation, arithmetic was so slow that there were professionals specialized in calculation. Calculation was manual work.
replacements.India · siglos V–VII · llegó a Europa ví: India · 5th–7th centuries · reached Europe via al-Khwarizmi
replacements.10 dígitos (0–9) y un principio posicion: Ten digits (0–9) and a positional principle: the value of each digit depends on its position. Zero is not merely absence, but an active symbol that shifts positions.
replacements.El mismo dígito, tres valores distintos:: The same digit, three different values:
replacements.Representar cualquier número con solo 10: Representing any number with only 10 symbols
replacements.No es eficiente en hardware electrónico: It is inefficient in electronic hardware (multiple voltage levels)
replacements.Con este sistema, seguir las reglas gara: With this system, following the rules guarantees the correct result. Calculation no longer requires intuition or manual verification.
replacements.Leibniz 1679 · adoptado en computación s: Leibniz 1679 · adopted in computing in the 20th century
replacements.Solo dos dígitos (0 y 1). La posición mu: Only two digits (0 and 1). Position multiplies by powers of 2. Its practical value is physical: 0 and 1 can be implemented as off/on states in an electrical circuit.
replacements.Operaciones lógicas (AND, OR, NOT) sobre: Logical operations (AND, OR, NOT) on the same digits
replacements.Transmisión fiable con mínimo error de s: Reliable transmission with minimal signal error
replacements.Representaciones más largas (13 necesita: Longer representations (13 needs 4 digits instead of 2 in decimal)
replacements.Difícil de leer directamente por humanos: Difficult for humans to read directly
replacements.El binario convierte el número en señal: Binary turns a number into a physical signal. That connects the world of abstract mathematics with electronic circuits.
